propositions: When a child ticket's direct parent cannot be represented in Jira due to type constraints (non-epic parent in epic-only project), the parent field is suppressed before outbound sync, leaving the child underdefined with no visible context.

An echo-safe breadcrumb comment must be emitted from the outbound comment differ to point the Jira user at the nearest ancestor with a bound Jira key, decorated with RECONCILER_MARKER for inbound suppression and a stable identity tag for dedup.

The breadcrumb is appended once per child via a stable tag scan of existing jira_comments; if the nearest represented ancestor changes across passes, no conflicting second breadcrumb is added (first-writer-wins).
When intervening ancestors lack bound Jira keys, the breadcrumb body names the bound ancestor and notes that intermediate levels are not represented in Jira.
The breadcrumb is suppressed inbound by RECONCILER_MARKER substring check in inbound_collection_diffs._diff_comments_inbound, preventing echo-loop.

Integration points are outbound_comments._diff_comments (breadcrumb build and append), outbound_mutation_builders._compute_outbound_update_mutation (parameter threading), and outbound_differ.compute_outbound_mutations (local_parents construction), with no changes to pass_io or CREATE path logic.
